title: dtcg-tokens
description: A W3C Design Tokens Community Group (DTCG) token document. A standards-based token-spec format design-parity accepts on the reference side (Figma Variables export, Tokens Studio). Every node is an object; a token carries '$value' (and optionally '$type'), a group nests further nodes. '$type' is inherited from the nearest ancestor group when omitted.

type.description: DTCG token type. design-parity consumes color, dimension, number, and the composite typography type; the rest validate but are not (yet) routed into DesignTokens.
